_comment: Example JSON payload for CertificateAssessment.ml_advisory and CertificateMLAdvisor.predict().to_dict(). This signal is auxiliary and non-authoritative.
advisory_notes: Advisory signal: predicted POLICY_COMPLIANT (99.98% probability). Normal profile consistent with standard Web PKI patterns. Note: This signal is advisory and does NOT supersede deterministic RFC validation.

guidelines_for_consumers.backend_usage: Store in db as ml_advisory_json. Do not use to override deterministic trust_score or verdict.
guidelines_for_consumers.frontend_usage: Display inside an expandable 'Machine Learning Intelligence' drawer with an 'Advisory Only' pill badge. Never display as the primary security indicator.
